headline: Get Panpanta
title: How to Get Panpanta | Beat the Alpha First | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Panpanta does not spawn in the wild, so you must evolve it. Catch a Popota in Echoback Landing, where wild ones are around levels thirty six to forty. Raise it to level thirty nine. Then defeat the Alpha Panpanta, the boss on the Echoback Landing shore, and open Aniimo Management to evolve. Check the stone cost on the screen first. Have you beaten the Alpha yet? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Check the cost in the menu

description: Panpanta comes from Popota: reach level 39 and defeat the Alpha Panpanta in Echoback Landing. Wild Popota are found in Echoback Landing around levels 36-40.
